case_text: A 60-year-old woman presents with progressive dyspnea, dry cough, and clubbing of the fingers. Chest CT reveals bilateral basal reticular opacities with honeycombing.

profile.suspected_diagnosis: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (usual interstitial pneumonia pattern)
labs: Chest CT reveals bilateral basal reticular opacities with honeycombing

criteria.text: Age ≥ 40 years
IPF diagnosis
Participants with IPF receiving locally approved antifibrotic therapies at a stable dose, or participants with IPF not receiving local standard of care
FVC ≥ 45% predicted of normal
DLCO corrected for hemoglobin ≥ 25% predicted of normal
ILD other than IPF
The extent of emphysema is greater than the extent of fibrotic changes on chest HRCT scan
Acute exacerbation of IPF
Lower respiratory tract infection requiring treatment
Acute coronary syndrome/acute myocardial infarction, unstable angina ± coronary intervention with Percutaneous Coronary Intervention, or Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting
Heart failure
History of organ transplantation or is likely to receive lung transplantation

judgments.evidence: 환자 나이 60세, 기준 40세 이상 → 해당 (코드 판정)

Q1 answer: "14개월 전에 폐 전문의에게 특발성 폐섬유증이라고 진단받았어요." (diagnosed with IPF by a pulmonologist 14 months ago). The patient is unsure about biopsy or multidisciplinary review, but the IPF diagnosis is on record.
Q4 answer: "닌테다닙 150mg을 하루 두 번, 8개월째 같은 용량으로 먹고 있어요." (nintedanib 150 mg twice daily, same dose for 8 months). This is an approved antifibrotic at a stable dose.
sub_condition_notes: Receiving an approved antifibrotic (nintedanib) at a stable dose: met
The alternative (not receiving standard of care) is not needed

judgments.evidence: Q5 answer: "폐활량이 예상치의 68%" (lung capacity 68% of predicted). The patient reports this as an FVC-type value, which is ≥ 45%. The result sheet is not in hand, but the reported value meets the threshold.
Q5 answer: "확산능력은 42% 정도" (diffusing capacity about 42%). This is above 25%, but it is unclear whether it was corrected for hemoglobin, and no hemoglobin value is given.
sub_condition_notes: DLCO 42% reported, which is above 25%
Hemoglobin correction not confirmed

judgments.evidence: Q1 answer states an IPF diagnosis, but the patient does not know whether a biopsy or multidisciplinary discussion was done. No other ILD is mentioned, and absence of mention does not exclude one.
Q6 answer: "폐기종이 아주 조금 있다고는 들었는데, 폐가 딱딱하게 굳는 섬유화가 주된 문제라고 하셨어요." (only a little emphysema; fibrosis is the main problem). Emphysema is therefore not greater than fibrosis.
Q2 answer: "갑자기 심해진 적은 없고 지난 1년 반 동안 서서히 조금씩 더 숨이 차졌어요. 폐 때문에 입원한 적도 없어요." (no sudden worsening, gradual progression, no hospitalization).
Q7 answer: "그런 감염으로 치료받았다는 기억은 따로 없어요. 입원한 적도 없고요." (no recollection of treatment for a lung infection, no hospitalization).
Q3 answer: "심근경색이나 협심증, 스텐트나 수술을 받은 적은 없는 걸로 알아요." (no MI, angina, stent, or surgery as far as the patient knows).
sub_condition_notes: Acute coronary syndrome/MI/unstable angina: denied
PCI/CABG: denied

judgments.evidence: Q3 answer: "지난달 심장 초음파를 했는데 심장 기능은 정상이라고 들었어요." (echocardiogram last month, cardiac function normal). No heart failure treatment is reported.
Q8 answer: "장기이식 수술을 받은 적은 없어요. 폐이식에 대해 들은 적이 있는지는 잘 모르겠어요." No prior transplant, but the patient is unsure whether lung transplant was discussed.
sub_condition_notes: History of organ transplantation: denied (pass)
Likely to receive lung transplantation: unknown

criteria.text: Patients ≥ 18 years of age
Patients with IPF diagnosis that fulfils ATS/ERS Consensus Criteria.

Patients hospitalised with a definite or suspected AE-IPF diagnosis, as defined by the international working group criteria and as ascertained by the responsible Primary Investigator. / The criteria of IPF-AE are as follows: / Previous or concurrent diagnosis of IPF / Acute worsening or development of dyspnoea typically < 1 month duration / Computed tomography with new bilateral ground-glass opacity and/or consolidation superimposed on a background pattern consistent with usual interstitial pneumonia pattern / Deterioration not fully explained by cardiac failure or fluid overload Patients who fail to meet all 4 criteria due to missing computed tomography should be considered as having "suspected Acute Exacerbation". / If the diagnosis of IPF is not previously established, this criterion can be met by the presence of radiologic and/or histopathologic changes consistent with usual interstitial pneumonia pattern on the current evaluation. / If no previous computed tomography is available, the qualifier "new" can be dropped from the third AE-IPF criterion.

Patient able to understand and sign a written informed consent form. In case of incapacity of the patient, the written informed consent form will be signed by the patients' legally authorized representative.
Patients with acute worsening due to uncontrolled heart failure or pulmonary embolism.
Patients with known hypersensitivity to corticosteroids, IVIG or any component of the study treatment.
Patients with known IgA deficiency (IgA level <7 mg/dL)- to preclude IVIG reactions.
Patients without a definite diagnosis of IPF or AE-IPF based on clinical, radiological, laboratory evaluation, and multidisciplinary discussion.

Patients with active malignancy or currently receiving cancer treatment, except for basal cell or squamous cell skin cancer or low-risk prostate cancer (T1 or T2a stage with PSA <10 ng/dL). These criteria are aligned with current guidelines.

Patients that have received treatment for >14 days within the preceding month with >20mg daily prednisone (or equivalent) or any treatment during the last month with immunosuppressants (e.g., cyclophosphamide, mycophenolate etc.) according to already published therapeutic protocols or > 1 mg/kg/d from more than 7 days in the last 15 days.
Patients participating to another interventional clinical trial.
Patients with documented pregnancy or lactation.
Patients under tutorship or curatorship.
Patients deprived of liberty or under court protection.
Patients who refuse to participate or decline to provide written informed consent.

judgments.evidence: 환자 나이 60세, 기준 18세 이상 → 해당 (코드 판정)

Q1 answer: "14개월 전에 폐 전문의에게 특발성 폐섬유증이라고 진단받았어요. 폐 조직검사나 여러 의사 협진을 받았는지는 잘 모르겠어요." CT shows honeycombing, but whether the diagnosis fulfils ATS/ERS criteria (multidisciplinary discussion, biopsy) is not confirmed.

Fulfilment of ATS/ERS consensus criteria not confirmed

questions.text: 지금까지 의사에게 폐 질환에 대해 어떤 병명(예: 특발성 폐섬유증, 간질성 폐질환, 폐기종)을 들으셨나요? 폐 조직검사나 여러 의사의 협의 진료를 받으신 적이 있다면 함께 알려주세요.
questions.needed_info: 폐 질환 진단명(특발성 폐섬유증 여부, 다른 간질성 폐질환, 폐기종)과 진단 과정

questions.text: 최근 한 달 사이에 숨찬 증상이 갑자기 심해져서 입원하거나 응급 치료를 받으신 적이 있나요?
questions.needed_info: 최근 호흡곤란의 급격한 악화 및 입원·응급 치료 여부

questions.text: 심근경색이나 협심증으로 치료받았거나 스텐트 시술·관상동맥 우회로 수술을 받은 적, 또는 심부전(심장 기능이 약해 숨이 차고 다리가 붓는 병)으로 치료받은 적이 있나요?
지금 드시거나 최근 한 달 사이에 드신 약을 알려주세요. 특히 폐섬유증 치료제(니answers 닌테다닙, 피르페니돈), 스테로이드(프레드니손 등), 면역억제제가 있는지 알려주세요.
questions.needed_info: 현재 및 최근 복용 약(항섬유화제, 스테로이드, 면역억제제)

questions.text: 폐기능검사(숨을 크게 불어 폐 능력을 재는 검사)나 폐확산능검사를 받으신 적이 있나요? 있다면 결과지를 가지고 계신지 알려주세요.
questions.needed_info: 폐기능검사(FVC, DLCO) 시행 여부와 결과지 보유 여부

answers.answer: 14개월 전에 폐 전문의에게 특발성 폐섬유증이라고 진단받았어요. 폐 조직검사나 여러 의사 협진을 받았는지는 잘 모르겠어요.
아니요, 갑자기 심해진 적은 없고 지난 1년 반 동안 서서히 조금씩 더 숨이 차졌어요. 폐 때문에 입원한 적도 없어요.
심근경색이나 협심증, 스텐트나 수술을 받은 적은 없는 걸로 알아요. 지난달 심장 초음파를 했는데 심장 기능은 정상이라고 들었어요.
닌테다닙 150mg을 하루 두 번, 8개월째 같은 용량으로 먹고 있어요. 그 외에 역류 때문에 오메프라졸 20mg, 갑상선저하증 때문에 레보티록신 75mcg를 매일 먹어요. 스테로이드나 면역억제제는 안 먹어요.
네, 검사를 받았어요. 폐활량이 예상치의 68%, 확산능력은 42% 정도라고 들었어요. 결과지를 제가 가지고 있는지는 잘 모르겠어요.

questions.text: 흉부 CT 결과를 들으실 때 폐기종(폐 조직이 망가져 공기가 찬 상태)이 있다는 말을 들으셨나요? CT 결과지를 가지고 계신지도 알려주세요.
questions.needed_info: 흉부 CT에서 폐기종 언급 여부와 CT 결과지 보유 여부

questions.text: 폐렴이나 기관지염처럼 폐나 기관지에 생기는 감염으로 항생제 등 치료를 받으신 적이 있나요?
장기이식 수술을 받은 적이 있거나, 의사에게 폐이식을 받게 될 수 있다는 말을 들으신 적이 있나요?
questions.needed_info: 장기이식 수술 경험 및 폐이식 가능성에 대한 설명 여부

answers.answer: 폐기종이 아주 조금 있다고는 들었는데, 폐가 딱딱하게 굳는 섬유화가 주된 문제라고 하셨어요. CT 결과지를 제가 가지고 있는지는 잘 모르겠어요.
그런 감염으로 치료받았다는 기억은 따로 없어요. 입원한 적도 없고요.
장기이식 수술을 받은 적은 없어요. 폐이식에 대해 들은 적이 있는지는 잘 모르겠어요.
